snippet.title: ADA: Tainted Soil - Trailer
snippet.description:
In ADA: Tainted Soil, players will embark into a dreamlike world filled with monsters to save their captured family members. They’ll need to harness a dark force that gives them ultimate power - at the risk of corrupting their very soul! Wishlist the game on Steam here. What’s more, a new public demo is also available on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535850/ADA_Tainted_Soil/
